raw.bookSourceComment: 可乐小说（人人搜书库），搜索使用AES-256-CBC加密。目录分页支持HTML首页+AJAX后续页，密钥动态提取+硬编码兜底。chapterList返回JS对象数组，chapterName/chapterUrl直接属性访问。v4.0

ruleToc.chapterList: var resStr = result.toString().trim(); var elements = []; if (resStr.charAt(0) == '{' || resStr.charAt(0) == '[') { var parsed = false; try { var json = JSON.parse(resStr); if (json.code == 0 && json.data && json.data.length > 0) { for (var i = 0; i < json.data.length; i++) { var ch = json.data[i]; elements.push({ chaptername: ch.chaptername, chapterurl: 'https://www.kelexs.com' + ch.chapterurl }); } parsed = true; } } catch (e) {} if (!parsed || elements.length == 0) { var nameRegex = /"chaptername":"([^"]+)"/g; var urlRegex = /"chapterurl":"([^"]+)"/g; var names = []; var urls = []; var m; while ((m = nameRegex.exec(resStr)) !== null) { names.push(m[1]); } while ((m = urlRegex.exec(resStr)) !== null) { urls.push(m[1]); } for (var i = 0; i < names.length && i < urls.length; i++) { elements.push({ chaptername: names[i], chapterurl: 'https://www.kelexs.com' + urls[i] }); } } } else { var startIdx = resStr.indexOf('class="chapList chapListBody"'); if (startIdx == -1) { startIdx = resStr.indexOf("class='chapList chapListBody'"); } if (startIdx != -1) { var endIdx = resStr.indexOf('', startIdx); if (endIdx != -1) { var section = resStr.substring(startIdx, endIdx + 5); var liRegex = //g; var m; while ((m = liRegex.exec(section)) !== null) { var aMatch = m[0].match(/]*href="([^"]+)"[^>]*>([^<]+)<\/a>/i); if (aMatch) { elements.push({ chaptername: aMatch[2], chapterurl: 'https://www.kelexs.com' + aMatch[1] }); } } } } } elements
ruleToc.nextTocUrl: <js>var resStr = result.toString().trim(); var nextUrl = ''; var id = ''; var currentPage = 1; var idMatch = baseUrl.match(/[?&]id=([^&]+)/); id = idMatch ? idMatch[1] : ''; if (!id) { var chapterMatch = baseUrl.match(/chapter\/([^.]+)\.html/); id = chapterMatch ? chapterMatch[1] : ''; } if (!id && book) { var bookMatch = book.bookUrl.match(/book\/([^.]+)\.html/); id = bookMatch ? bookMatch[1] : ''; } var pageMatch = baseUrl.match(/[?&]page=(\d+)/); if (pageMatch) { currentPage = parseInt(pageMatch[1]); } if (id) { var hasMore = false; if (resStr.charAt(0) == '{' || resStr.charAt(0) == '[') { try { var json = JSON.parse(resStr); if (json.code == 0 && json.data) { if (json.data.length >= 100) { hasMore = true; } } } catch (e) { var countMatch = resStr.match(/"chaptername"/g); if (countMatch && countMatch.length >= 100) { hasMore = true; } } } else { var countMatch = resStr.match(/<li[\s>]/g); if (countMatch && countMatch.length >= 100) { hasMore = true; } } if (hasMore) { var nextPage = currentPage + 1; var keyStr = cache.get('kelexs_key'); var ivStr = cache.get('kelexs_iv'); if (!keyStr || !ivStr) { try { var html = java.ajax(book.bookUrl); if (html) { var jsMatch = html.match(/script type="text\/javascript" src="(\/templates\/js\/[A-Za-z0-9]+\.js)"/) || html.match(/src="(\/templates\/js\/[A-Za-z0-9]+\.js)"/); if (jsMatch) { var jsUrl = 'https://www.kelexs.com' + jsMatch[1]; var jsContent = java.ajax(jsUrl); if (jsContent) { var keyMatch = jsContent.match(/new AESCrypt\('([A-Za-z0-9]{32})'\)/); var ivMatch = jsContent.match(/CryptoJS\.enc\.Utf8\.parse\('(\d{16})'\)/); if (keyMatch) { keyStr = keyMatch[1]; cache.put('kelexs_key', keyStr, 86400); } if (ivMatch) { ivStr = ivMatch[1]; cache.put('kelexs_iv', ivStr, 86400); } } } } } catch (e) {} if (!keyStr) { keyStr = 'fx2zcphhn3MhznJlrfGMXN7ZefBa6eny'; } if (!ivStr) { ivStr = '5486678252717425'; } } if (keyStr && ivStr) { var crypto = java.createSymmetricCrypto('AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding', keyStr, ivStr); var data = JSON.stringify({id: id, page: nextPage}); var enc = crypto.encryptBase64(data); nextUrl = 'https://www.kelexs.com/index.php?action=loadChapterPage&id=' + id + '&page=' + nextPage + ',{"method":"POST","body":"data=' + enc + '"}'; } } } nextUrl</js>
